name: Shiftboard
startupIdea: Shift scheduling software for warehouses that builds weekly rotas from staff availability and labour rules, and lets workers swap shifts from their phone with manager approval.
targetAudience: operations managers at warehouses with 50 to 500 hourly staff
differentiator: Checks every rota against local labour rules before it is published

name: Tallypot
startupIdea: A business current account for freelancers that automatically moves a share of every incoming payment into a tax pot and sends invoices that chase late payers.
targetAudience: UK freelancers and sole traders who dread tax season
differentiator: Tax set-aside happens the moment money lands, not at year end

name: HomeHelp Circle
startupIdea: An in-home care service that matches older adults with a small, consistent team of vetted carers for daily help, companionship and medication reminders, arranged with one phone call.
targetAudience: adults over 75 living at home and their adult children
differentiator: The same two or three carers every week, never a stranger

name: Mathbeans
startupIdea: A maths practice app for children aged 6 to 10 with ten-minute puzzle games that adapt to each child, plus a weekly progress email for parents.
targetAudience: parents of primary school children who struggle with maths
differentiator: No ads and no in-app purchases, ever

name: Mosswell
startupIdea: A three-step skincare routine for sensitive skin made with short, fully disclosed ingredient lists, sold direct as a subscription that ships every eight weeks.
targetAudience: adults with sensitive or reactive skin tired of guessing at ingredients
differentiator: Every ingredient and its purpose is listed on the front of the bottle

name: Coach Dana Strength
startupIdea: Online strength coaching from a certified personal trainer: a custom 12-week programme, weekly video form checks and a monthly call, for people training at home or in a gym.
targetAudience: busy adults in their 30s and 40s who want to get strong without injury
differentiator: Every programme is written by the coach herself, not generated

name: Harbor Lane Law
startupIdea: A small law firm handling tenancy disputes for renters, offering a fixed-fee first consultation and plain-English letters to landlords.
targetAudience: renters facing deposit disputes, repairs refusals or eviction notices
differentiator: Fixed fees agreed up front, no hourly billing surprises

name: Tracelight
startupIdea: An open-source tool that records production errors with the exact request and database queries that caused them, and replays them locally with one command.
targetAudience: backend engineers at startups debugging production issues
differentiator: Replays the failing request locally instead of just showing a stack trace
pricePositioning: free open source with a paid cloud tier

name: Little Ember
startupIdea: A neighbourhood wood-fired restaurant with a short seasonal menu that changes weekly, open Wednesday to Sunday evenings, with online table booking.
targetAudience: local couples and small groups looking for a relaxed dinner out
differentiator: Everything is cooked over the wood fire, including dessert

name: Second Shelf
startupIdea: A non-profit that collects surplus food from supermarkets and delivers it to community pantries the same day, run by volunteers who can sign up for two-hour driving shifts.
targetAudience: local residents who want to volunteer or donate
differentiator: Same-day delivery so fresh food is never wasted
